cases.question: How do I enter players on my roster?
cases.answer:
To enter players on your roster:

1. Go to your Captain Dashboard.
2. In Captain Tools, click Manage Roster.
3. Click Add Player.
4. In the pop-up, your home community is preselected; use the drop-down to view available players, including eligibility status and DUPR ratings.
5. Select the player and add them to the team.

If the player is missing a DUPR ID or Season Rating, select the player and click Add Player to Team; League Management will automatically be notified to review it and update you. If a player is marked “Not Eligible,” trying to add them will show an on-screen message explaining why.

cases.question: How can I update my roster?
cases.answer:
To update your team roster, go to the Captain Tools section on your Captain Dashboard and click Manage Roster. From there you can add, change, or remove players.

For adding a player: click Add Player, use the pop-up/drop-down to view available players, eligibility status, and DUPR ratings, then add the player. If a player is missing a DUPR ID or Season Rating, you can select the player and click Add Player to Team; League Management will be notified to review it and update you. If a player is marked “Not Eligible,” the system will show an on-screen message explaining why.

To change a Captain or Co-Captain, use Change Captain/Co-Captain next to your team name; it opens an email draft to send the request to League Management.

cases.question: How do I enter match scores?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide

cases.answer:
To enter match scores:

1. On or after the scheduled match date, click the red Enter Match Scores button in the match.
2. Select the players for each game using the dropdowns, normally using the saved Match Setup team; if there were changes, choose the correct players individually.
3. Enter the scores in each game block.
4. Click Submit. The system checks for errors before saving.
5. The opposing captain then receives a verification request and must review the scores, then verify or dispute them. The visiting captain must verify promptly.

Notes: For individual game forfeits or retirements, refer to the official League Rules. If the entire match date is forfeited or cannot be played due to weather or scheduling conflicts, do not enter it in the system; contact League Management at info@lwrpickleballclub.com.

LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide — ENTER/VERIFY SCORES — Page 9
